resources.string: In MeshCentral, open My Account → Login Tokens and create a token. Enter its username (~t:…) in Username and its token password in Password. Do not use your account username or a two-factor code.
If your server link contains ?key=…, enter only that key here. This is separate from a login token.
This server requires an access key. Open Server settings and enter the key from your server link (?key=…).
